name: docx-editor
description: Open-source WYSIWYG .docx editor library with canonical OOXML, tracked changes, and real-time collaboration. Agent-ready. https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48692474

paragraphs: 📦 Archive — not maintained. A preserved copy of Eigenpal's @eigenpal/docx-editor, captured after the project went dark in June 2026 (both the repo and docx-editor.dev went offline). Forked from sorenlouv/docx-editor — the most recent surviving fork I could find of the original. The package versions here are v1.9.0, matching the last release still published on npm (@eigenpal/docx-editor-core / -react / -agents / -i18n). Apache-2.0 licensed as per original repo. Kept read-only for archival/reference; nothing is changed here.
